headline: Every biscuit pack checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to your bakery
heroLede: Koulourakia and biscota in several flavours go into similar packs, so the label is what tells them apart. Here's what a camera check could look like on your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every pack is sealed straight across, with no crease and no crumbs caught in the seal. A weak seal means stale biscuits and a complaint.
labelLede: A vanilla pack and a sesame pack can look much the same at line speed, and sesame is a declared allergen. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every pack. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Film offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes. Check the wrapper.
